subject: Redwood evaluation kickoff - scheduling and success criteria (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood evaluation kickoff - next steps

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the great discovery call today. Quick recap of what I heard:
- Primary goal: reduce query latency on customer-facing recommendation flows and lower token cost for LLM responses while maintaining parity in quality.
- Key success criteria: 95th %ile latency < 150ms for 1k token windows; <10% regression on relevance compared to current baseline; predictable unit cost under $0.002/token for steady-state.
- Evaluation scope: 2-week trial with 1 model variant (quantized) plus a higher-quality fallback; we’ll run prompt/eval sets you provide plus our standard benchmarks.

Next step: schedule a 60–75 minute evaluation kickoff (trial plan + technical deep dive + calendar alignment). Would next week work? I’m proposing these slots (PT):
- Wed Feb 24 — 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Wed Feb 24 — 2:00–3:15 PM PT
- Thu Feb 25 — 9:00–10:15 AM PT

I’ve attached a draft eval plan with milestones and deliverables (redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf). For the technical portion, I’ll loop in our solutions engineer to review integration points and any data access needs.

Can you confirm a preferred slot and who at Acme should own security/compliance questions (SOC 2, data handling)? If you can share a short list of sample prompts or a small representative dataset ahead of the call, that will help our prep.

Thanks — looking forward to running this together.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)

Connor —

Appreciate the recap and draft plan. Those success criteria look right. We can do Wed Feb 24 at 10:00 AM PT. I’ll own the security questions; looping in Priya (cc'd) from our security team.

1) Please include a 20–30 minute technical deep dive so our infra folks can review KV cache, batching, and network egress assumptions.
2) Can you share your SOC 2 summary and any documentation on data retention/audit logs?
3) I’ll send over a brief set of 12 sample prompts (redacted customer identifiers) by EOD Monday.

Confirming: Wed 2/24 10:00 AM PT for the 75-minute kickoff.
